name: Abrahamson (2007) soil-site plane-wave coherency
applicability: Soil sites with VS30 of 180-290 m/s, surface (or shallowly embedded) foundations; all magnitudes and distances; separations 0-150 m (EPRI 1015110 Section 7 'Applicability of the Soil Coherency Model' and Section 8). The regression used frequencies up to 20 Hz.
equation: gamma_pw(f, xi) = [1 + (f tanh(a3 xi) / (a1 fc(xi)))^n1]^(-1/2) * [1 + (f tanh(a3 xi) / a2(xi))^n2]^(-1/2)

source.primary: N. A. Abrahamson (2007). Program on Technology Innovation: Effects of Spatial Incoherence on Seismic Ground Motions. EPRI 1015110, Electric Power Research Institute, Palo Alto, CA, and U.S. DOE, December 2007 (NRC ADAMS ML090960409).
source.equation: Chapter 7 'Soil Coherency Model', Equation 7-1, report page 7-1 (PDF page 87).
source.tables: Table 7-1 'Plane-Wave Coherency Model Coefficients for the Horizontal Component' and Table 7-2 '... for the Vertical Component', report page 7-2 (PDF page 88).
source.transcription_note: Table 7-1 gives a2 = 15.8 - 0.044 xi and fc = 14.3 - 2.35 ln(xi+1); both become non-positive beyond the published separation range (a2 at 359 m, fc at 438 m), therefore separations are limited to formula_max_m (see sassi.core.coherency).
